fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Our stable id for the credential (also its page slug).

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: The credential's name as the issuer writes it.

fields.name: issuer
fields.meaning: Issuer id.

fields.name: issuer_name
fields.meaning: The issuer's name.

fields.name: family
fields.meaning: The issuer's named programme it belongs to, as an id.

fields.name: kind
fields.meaning: exam, course-certificate, assessment or microcredential.

fields.name: level
fields.meaning: The issuer's own tier word: foundational, associate, professional, specialty or expert.

fields.name: exam_code
fields.meaning: Exam code as the issuer writes it (AI-102, AIF-C01).

fields.name: credential_code
fields.meaning: The credential's own code or abbreviation (AIGP, AAISM).

fields.name: eligibility
fields.meaning: Who can take it, in the issuer's words.

fields.name: prerequisites
fields.meaning: Required or recommended experience, in the issuer's words.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Price rows as the issuer shows them, never converted: label, amount, currency, tax, billing, region_note.

fields.name: delivery_modes
fields.meaning: How it can be taken: online-proctored, test-center, self-paced or online-assessment.

fields.name: proctoring
fields.meaning: Proctoring as the issuer states it.

fields.name: exam_length_minutes
fields.meaning: Exam length in minutes.

fields.name: question_count
fields.meaning: Number of questions: min and max (equal when the issuer states one number).

fields.name: passing_score
fields.meaning: The score needed to pass, in the issuer's wording.

fields.name: validity_months
fields.meaning: How long it stays valid, in months.

fields.name: no_expiry
fields.meaning: true when the issuer states that the credential has no expiry date.

fields.name: renewal
fields.meaning: How to renew, in the issuer's words.

fields.name: languages
fields.meaning: Exam languages.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Status in the issuer's word, for example active, beta or announced.

fields.name: launch_date
fields.meaning: Launch date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: retirement_date
fields.meaning: Retirement date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: replaced_by
fields.meaning: Id of the credential the issuer names as its replacement.

fields.name: replaces
fields.meaning: Ids of the credentials it replaces.

fields.name: official_prep
fields.meaning: Where the issuer says its official preparation is, in its words.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.meaning: The issuer's pages the facts come from.

fields.name: last_checked
fields.meaning: The day we last checked the record against the issuer's pages (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: last_changed
fields.meaning: The day a check last found a changed value (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: url
fields.meaning: Where the credential is shown on this site.
